name: console-panel
purpose: A full-width framed panel that presents a product scene (a console mock or a diagram) under a section title, on a texture, with optional tabs that each play one beat of the scene. The scene is a slot: the page passes a `ShellMockup`, `ProductWidget` or diagram and reads the selected tab from the slot scope. In `console` kind the scene keeps a 1.9:1 aspect and can be cropped and faded at the bottom. From the design sample's site `ConsolePanel`.
useWhen: Showing the product itself on a landing page.
A tour of three or four views of one screen.
avoidWhen: For a screenshot with copy beside it — use `MediaSplitBand`.
bestPractices: Two to four tabs, each a different view, labelled with one word.
Crop the scene only to remove empty space at its bottom (0.1–0.3).

props.name: kind
props.doc: What the panel frames: `console` crops and fades a console mock at a fixed aspect, `diagram` lets a scene keep its own height.

props.name: titlePadding
props.doc: Vertical padding of the headline block.

props.name: size
props.doc: Step of the headline on the heading scale.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered as its `h2`.

props.name: description
props.doc: One or two sentences under the headline.

props.name: texture
props.doc: Texture the panel is grounded with.

props.name: textureFade
props.doc: Axis the texture fades out along.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: Tabs over the frame, each `{ value, title }`; each plays its own beat of the scene.

props.name: tabsAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the tab control; empty uses the built-in "Console views".

props.name: crop
props.doc: Share of the scene height clipped off its bottom, from 0 to 0.5, from the medium breakpoint up.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Buttons under the headline; each is `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`, the first secondary, the rest outlined.

slots.name: scene
slots.notes: undefined }` | The scene the band presents; `tab` is the selected tab value (undefined without tabs).

examples.name: Default
Diagram
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ConsolePanel from '@aziontech/webkit/console-panel'
  import Illustration from '@aziontech/webkit/illustration'
</script>

<template>
  <ConsolePanel
    kind="diagram"
    title="Requests take the shortest path"
    :actions="[{ label: 'See the network', href: '/network', trailing: true }]"
  >
    <template #scene>
      <Illustration
        name="global-network"
        aria-label="Requests routed to the nearest location"
        class="max-w-(--container-lg)"
      />
    </template>
  </ConsolePanel>
</template>
